name: flutter_search
desc: Search for classes, functions, widgets, and other Dart elements. Use flutter_get_code_block to get full function/class bodies.

name: flutter_get_stats
desc: Get summary statistics of the Flutter project index

name: flutter_get_project_structure
desc: Get the structure of the project (folders and files), specifically focusing on the lib/ directory.

name: flutter_get_file_info
desc: Get detailed information about a specific Dart file
args: args: { relativePath?: string; filePath?: string; path?: string }

name: flutter_get_pubspec
desc: Get code warnings (like hardcoded text, colors, duplicated code/logic, and mockups) from the Dart project with optional filtering
args: { typeFilter, searchQuery, fileQuery }: { typeFilter?: string; searchQuery?: string; fileQuery?: string }

name: flutter_detect_mockups
desc: Scan Flutter project to detect mockup, dummy, placeholder, and unimplemented UI code (empty callbacks, hardcoded mock data, stub widgets, unbound inputs, fake delays, TODO comments)
args: { category, filePath }: { category?: string; filePath?: string }

name: flutter_get_diagnostics
desc: Get VS Code diagnostics (errors and warnings) for the project, optionally filtered by file or severity
args: args: { filePath?: string; relativePath?: string; path?: string; severity?: "error" | "warning" | "info" }

name: flutter_get_missing_translations
desc: Find missing translation keys across all ARB files

name: flutter_update_translation
desc: Update or add a translation key across all ARB files, supporting dynamic multi-locale maps or Arabic/English values
args: { key, arValue, enValue, translations, description, placeholders }

name: flutter_delete_translation
desc: Delete a translation key from all ARB files

name: flutter_list_translations
desc: List all translation keys and check for missing keys across ARB files

name: flutter_get_impact_analysis
desc: Get reverse dependencies for a class or function (what depends on this element)

name: flutter_set_project_path
desc: Set the Flutter project root path for the MCP server

name: flutter_get_project_path
desc: Get the current Flutter project root path

name: flutter_get_node_at_cursor
desc: Find the Dart element (class/function) at a specific cursor position in a file.

name: flutter_list_packages
desc: List all project dependencies from pubspec.lock

name: flutter_get_code_block
desc: Get the full body of a class, function, or method including comments

name: flutter_analyze_logic_flow
desc: Get the dependencies (repositories, services, etc.) that a class depends on from its constructor
args: { className, filePath }: { className: string; filePath?: string }

name: flutter_read_fragment
desc: Read a code fragment by element name (class, function, method) with surrounding comments

name: flutter_search_text
desc: Search for specific text, strings, or comments across all Dart files
args: options: { query: string; isRegex?: boolean; caseInsensitive?: boolean; includeComments?: boolean; includeStrings?: boolean }

name: flutter_get_index_status
desc: Check the status and last update time of the project index

name: flutter_get_detailed_graph
desc: Get a detailed relationship graph (inheritance, calls, imports) for the project or a specific file

name: flutter_get_hints
desc: Get context-aware suggestions for the next steps based on recent analysis

name: flutter_read_lines
desc: Read a specific range of lines from any file in the project with 1-based line numbers. Highly recommended for inspecting code around errors or reviewing large files without token bloat.

name: flutter_run_analyze
desc: Run compiler checks or linters on the current project based on its detected type (Flutter, TS/JS, Android), optionally targeting a specific file or directory.
args: analyzeArgs?: { targetPath?: string; filePath?: string; path?: string }

name: flutter_run_build_runner
desc: Find all usages/references of a class, function, variable, enum, mixin, extension, or typedef in the project.

name: flutter_run_intl_generate
desc: Manually trigger Intl generation (l10n.dart, messages_*.dart) via the built-in IntlGenerator. This will read the ARB files and write the generated Dart files.

name: flutter_rebuild_index
desc: Manually trigger a full re-index of the Flutter project by the VS Code extension.

name: flutter_search_packages
desc: Search across all cached third-party Dart/Flutter package dependencies in .pub-cache or Flutter SDK (similar to rip_grep_packages).

name: flutter_read_package_source
desc: Read the source code of any cached third-party package or Flutter SDK library by package URI (e.g. package:flutter/material.dart or package:dio/dio.dart).

name: flutter_pub_dev_search
desc: Live search for packages on pub.dev to discover libraries, popularity, descriptions, and latest versions.

name: flutter_get_pub_package_info
desc: Get detailed metrics for a package from pub.dev, including pub points, popularity score, likes, description, and repository.

name: flutter_hot_reload
desc: Trigger Hot Reload (ext.flutter.reassemble) on the running Flutter app via the Dart VM Service.

name: flutter_hot_restart
desc: Trigger a full Hot Restart on the running Flutter application via the Dart VM Service.

name: flutter_get_runtime_errors
desc: Fetch real-time Flutter runtime errors, uncaught exceptions, and stderr logs from the running application.

name: flutter_inspect_live_widgets
desc: Inspect the live running widget tree and render objects of the active Flutter application.

name: flutter_find_unused_translations
desc: Scan all ARB translation keys and compare with lib/ code to find unused/dead translation keys.

name: flutter_validate_icu_translations
desc: Validate ICU syntax, placeholder consistency ({name}), and plural balance across all ARB translation files.

name: flutter_auto_translate_missing
desc: Generate structured translation payload for missing keys across locales, or batch apply translated keys.

name: flutter_detect_circular_dependencies
desc: Detect circular dependency cycles across project files (A -> B -> C -> A) to prevent architectural degradation.

name: flutter_validate_architecture_rules
desc: Validate layer boundary rules (e.g. Domain must not depend on Data/UI, Core must not depend on Features).

name: flutter_detect_unused_assets
desc: Scan pubspec.yaml asset directories and detect unused/unreferenced image, icon, or data assets.

name: flutter_get_git_blast_radius
desc: Automatically calculate blast radius and affected entry points/execution flows from current Git diff changes.

name: flutter_analyze_widget_depth
desc: Analyze widget hierarchy nesting depth across project files and detect excessive nesting exceeding thresholds (inspired by DCM widget-nesting-depth).

name: flutter_detect_duplicate_widgets
desc: Detect duplicate or near-identical widget subtrees across project files and generate proposals for extracting reusable custom widgets (inspired by DCM Duplicate Widget Analyzer).

name: flutter_detect_memory_leaks
desc: Detect potential memory leaks and undisposed controllers (TextEditingController, AnimationController, ScrollController, StreamSubscription, FocusNode, etc.) in State classes (inspired by leak_tracker & saropa_lints).

name: flutter_simulate_ui_action
desc: Simulate user UI interactions (tap, enterText, scroll) on the live running Flutter app via VM Service (inspired by Marionette MCP & Flutter Driver).

name: flutter_get_architectural_layers
desc: Classify project files into Clean Architecture layers (Presentation, Domain, Data, Core), calculate Lakos coupling metrics (Ca, Ce, Instability), and detect cross-layer violations (inspired by Lakos Architecture Visualizer).
